repos_data.description: Feature-packed native macOS screenshot & recording tool: annotate, auto-redact PII, record GIFs, OCR + translate, scroll capture, beautify, and more. No Electron, no subscription.
Open-source screenshot and screen recording for macOS. The free, native alternative to CleanShot X. Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI.
Minimalist macOS OCR tool. Open-source, privacy-first, and built with SwiftUI.

A lightweight macOS selection translator built with pure Swift 6, featuring on-device Apple Translate for privacy, only 5MB install size and stable ~50MB memory usage. 一款轻量级 macOS 划词翻译工具，纯 Swift 6 开发，设备端 Apple 翻译保护隐私，安装体积仅 5MB，后台运行内存稳定约 50MB
An open-source native macOS screenshot and screen recording app. A CleanShot X alternative.
Screen translation app for macOS — select any area, get instant translation. On-device by default with Apple Vision OCR + Apple Translation.
OneClip——A simple and professional native clipboard manager for macOS ｜简单专业的macOS原生剪贴板工具｜还支持轻量级截图/长截图、OCR、划词翻译、拖拽容器、堆栈、PopClip、AI 集成、剪贴板同步等
Open-source MCP server for FreezeText — OCR anything on your Mac screen from Claude/Cursor. Screen capture, region OCR, image OCR, searchable history.
A free and open-source collection of native macOS menu bar tools.
A macOS voice, screenshot, clipboard, and coding-agent workbench.
Private, native macOS app to capture pages, text, notes, links, and images—and find them instantly with full-text search and OCR. Open source; no account or telemetry.

repo_meta_data.description: ⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
